## Description

A flat plate of 16 (sometimes 4, 8 or 32) biflagellate cells of 5–14 µm arranged in two concentric
squares (4 + 12), one cell thick; the colony (~40 µm) swims rotating like a wheel towards light at
~40 µm/s. In nature each cell of the colony divides 4–5 times and forms an entire daughter colony
(autocolony).

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 4 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A plate one cell thick (~9 µm) with the `plate_colony` style; phototactic. The colony releases 4
[daughter colonies](../../mechanics/stalks-and-colonies.md#other-colonies) that share the biomass the same way, so
the growth rate does not change, only the number of colonies per event. `colony_cells` is only the
drawing.

## Literature

- de Maleprade H., Moisy F., Ishikawa T., Goldstein R.E. (2020) Motility and phototaxis of *Gonium*,
  the simplest differentiated colonial alga. Phys. Rev. E 101: 022416 (~40 µm/s).
- Saito (1984) measured 5.8 doublings/day in *G. multicoccum* in an organic medium (not used).

## Unique and shared mechanics

First step of the volvocine series with *Pandorina*, *Eudorina* and *Volvox*.
